findings.title: Vendor liable for subcontractor damages
findings.fact: Vendor shall be and remain liable for all damages to the State of Delaware caused by negligent performance or non-performance of work by its subcontractor or sub-subcontractor.

quotes.quote: Further, vendor shall be and remain liable for all damages to the State of Delaware caused by negligent performance or non-performance of work by its subcontractor or its sub-subcontractor.

findings.title: Prime vendor solely responsible for contract performance
findings.fact: The prime vendor is solely responsible for fulfillment of any contract with the State and for management of all subcontractors.

quotes.quote: Any contract that may result from this RFP shall specify that the prime vendor is solely responsible for fulfillment of any contract with the State as a result of this procurement.
The prime vendor shall be wholly responsible for the entire contract performance whether or not subcontractors are used.

findings.title: Vendor responsible for completeness and accuracy of proposal
findings.fact: Vendor is fully responsible for the completeness and accuracy of their proposal and for examining the RFP and all addenda; failure to do so is at the sole risk of vendor.

quotes.quote: Vendor is fully responsible for the completeness and accuracy of their proposal, and for examining this RFP and all addenda. Failure to do so will be at the sole risk of vendor.

findings.title: State not liable for vendor cost overruns
findings.fact: The State of Delaware shall bear no responsibility or increase obligation for a vendor's failure to accurately estimate the costs or resources required to meet the obligations defined in the proposal.

quotes.quote: The State of Delaware shall bear no responsibility or increase obligation for a vendor’s failure to accurately estimate the costs or resources required to meet the obligations defined in the proposal.

findings.title: Vendor assumes risk of confidential information disclosure
findings.fact: Vendor assumes the risk that confidential business information included in a proposal may enter the public domain.

quotes.quote: Accordingly, vendor(s) assume the risk that confidential business information included in a proposal may enter the public domain.

findings.title: Warranty against collusion and fraud
findings.fact: By responding, the vendor warrants that its proposal is not made in connection with any competing vendor and is fair and without collusion or fraud.

quotes.quote: By responding, the vendor shall be deemed to have represented and warranted that its proposal is not made in connection with any competing vendor submitting a separate response to this RFP, and is in all respects fair and without collusion or fraud; that the vendor did not participate in the RFP development process and had no knowledge of the specific contents of the RFP prior to its issuance; and that no employee or official of the State of Delaware participated directly or indirectly in the vendor’s proposal preparation.

findings.title: Warranty against contingent fees
findings.fact: The selected vendor warrants that no person or selling agency has been employed or retained to solicit or secure a contract upon agreement for a commission, percentage, brokerage or contingent fee.

quotes.quote: The selected vendor will warrant that no person or selling agency has been employed or retained to solicit or secure a contract resulting from this RFP upon agreement or understanding for a commission, or a percentage, brokerage or contingent fee.

findings.title: State may annul contract for breach of warranty
findings.fact: For breach or violation of the warranty against contingent fees, the State may annul the contract without liability or deduct the full amount of such commission from the contract price.

quotes.quote: For breach or violation of this warranty, the State of Delaware shall have the right to annul any contract resulting from this RFP without liability or at its discretion deduct from the contract price or otherwise recover the full amount of such commission, percentage, brokerage or contingent fee.

findings.title: State may terminate negotiations at any time
findings.fact: The State may terminate negotiations at any time and for any reason, or for no reason.

quotes.quote: The State of Delaware may terminate negotiations at any time and for any reason, or for no reason.

findings.title: State may cancel solicitation at any time
findings.fact: The State reserves the right to cancel this solicitation at any time during the procurement process, for any reason or for no reason.

quotes.quote: The State of Delaware reserves the right to cancel this solicitation at any time during the procurement process, for any reason or for no reason.

findings.title: Vendor must maintain insurance
findings.fact: Proof of insurance and amount of insurance shall be furnished to the Agency prior to the start of the contract period and shall be no less than as identified in the bid solicitation, Section V, Item G, subsection 8 (Insurance).

quotes.quote: Proof of insurance and amount of insurance shall be furnished to the Agency prior to the start of the contract period and shall be no less than as identified in the bid solicitation, Section V, Item G, subsection 8 (Insurance).

findings.title: Contract contingent on appropriation
findings.fact: Contract term is one year, contingent on appropriation; funding in subsequent fiscal years is not a renewal right.

quotes.quote: Contract term is one (1) year, anticipated July 1, 2027 through June 30, 2028, contingent on appropriation. Funding in subsequent fiscal years is not a renewal right: continued funding is subject to the annual statutory process under 16 Del. C. § 137(i), including the annual request for proposals, and to annual appropriation.

findings.title: Vendor must execute contract within 20 days
findings.fact: The successful vendor shall promptly execute a contract incorporating the terms of this RFP within twenty (20) days after award of the contract.

quotes.quote: The successful vendor shall promptly execute a contract incorporating the terms of this RFP within twenty (20) days after award of the contract.

findings.title: Award annulled if vendor fails to enter agreement
findings.fact: If the vendor to whom the award is made fails to enter into the agreement as provided, the award will be annulled, and an award may be made to another vendor.

quotes.quote: If the vendor to whom the award is made fails to enter into the agreement as herein provided, the award will be annulled, and an award may be made to another vendor.

findings.title: State may extend contract month-to-month
findings.fact: The State reserves the right to extend this contract on a month-to-month basis for a period of up to three months after the term of the full contract has been completed.

quotes.quote: The State reserves the right to extend this contract on a month-to-month basis for a period of up to three months after the term of the full contract has been completed.
